findings.problem: Besides ungefähr, which the hint rules out, rund and circa (ca.) are also common, correct answers for about or roughly before a number, so the hint still allows more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: before a number; not ungefähr, rund or circa

back.target: about, approximately, roughly (before a number or amount)

note: Etwa is also common in questions to mean by any chance, as in "Bist du etwa krank?", which the editor might consider for a later card.
